events.content:
Migrated the project to the App Router. The home and about pages now live in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and [app/about/page.tsx](/workspace/app/about/page.tsx). The new [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) provides the HTML structure and shared metadata; the about page overrides its title and description. Internal links use `next/link`, and the `pages` directory and its Pages Router files are removed.

`npm run build` passed. I also ran the production server and confirmed `/` and `/about` return the expected content. The existing `/contact` link still leads to a 404, as it did before the migration.
